dedupe_keys.name: localisation de la borne de recharge pour a sixt sur aff 2017 2018

description: Localisation de la borne de recharge pour à Sixt-sur-Aff (2017-2018) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Commune de Sixt-sur-Aff. Geolocation of the charging station for electric vehicles in the municipality of Sixt-sur-Aff. Two datasets containing geographical location and technical characteristics of the charging point for electric vehicles for the years 2017 and 2018. Coverage: Commune de Sixt-sur-Aff. The portal shows the English title as "Location of the electric vehicle charging station in Sixt-sur-Aff (2017-2018)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Commune de Sixt-sur-Aff. Its keywords include borne-de-recharge, localisation, vehicule-electrique, bornes-electriques. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
